note: Product definitions for the four payment capabilities (UI copy). The adapters in backend/xrpl/commerce/ are the source of truth for behaviour; a test keeps these in step.

mission.title: Rose’s purchasing mission
mission.task: Buy validated XRPL ledger reports for the finance team
mission.payer: Rose Mitchell, CFO (fictional persona; Devnet demo key held by the operator)
mission.consent: Rose signs once. Her agent may buy only this, only from these sellers, only within these limits, until the expiry. Anything else is refused with a receipt.

rails.name: XRP Micropayments
can: Many small payments under one signature
Instant off-ledger claims, settled on the ledger
Proven on Mainnet (Oct 20–22, before this hackathon)
cannot: Carry RLUSD or other tokens (XRP only)
Settle without the seller redeeming its claim
proof: Payment-channel claim redeemed on the ledger

evidence.detail: Real Mainnet purchases on 2026-10-22, before this hackathon. Rose’s live run during the event waits for her signature.

rails.name: Stablecoin Payments
can: Exact-amount payments to the seller’s trust line
Network fee paid in XRP, shown separately
cannot: Use XRP payment channels (tokens need a direct Payment)
Pay a seller without an RLUSD trust line
Run on Devnet (no official RLUSD there)
proof: Delivered amount equals the exact RLUSD amount, issuer and currency

evidence.detail: Built and tested offline. A Testnet RLUSD payment needs the owner’s approval.

rails.name: Sponsored Execution
can: Onboard an agent account with 1 drop
Eterna pays the agent’s fees and reserves
cannot: Sponsor reserves on a delegated transaction (the ledger forbids it)
Run on Mainnet yet (amendment not enabled)
proof: The ledger records Eterna as sponsor

evidence.detail: Rose’s Devnet mission, run during the hackathon: sponsored agent account and sponsored delegation, re-read by two readers. Rose is fictional; her approval uses a Devnet demo key held by the operator.

rails.eligibleNote: Eligible · Eterna pays the agent’s fees and eligible reserves.

rails.name: Voucher Commerce
cannot: Treat a signed voucher as settlement
Use Mastercard’s network yet (no sandbox access; vouchers are simulated locally)
proof: Redemption settled by a separate, verified ledger payment

evidence.detail: Vouchers from Eterna’s local simulator, not Mastercard. Their settlement is a verified Devnet payment.

supporting.name: Delegated Authority
supporting.detail: Lets the agent sign on Rose’s behalf with only the permissions she grants. Supports any rail; it is not a payment rail. On Devnet, Rose (fictional) approves with a demo key held by the operator.
